INTRODUCTIONM
Data distributor circuits choose which of several outputs will receive data from a single input. ............................................
If the adder output is selected, the distributor will furnish data to the adder only.............................................................................
If the subtractor output is selected, the distributor will furnish data to the subtractor only...........................................
If the adder and subtractor circuits both require the same data, the distributor will demultiplex the input and furnish data to both of its outputs.
If both outputs are needed, the data is demultiplexed and applied to both outputs..
DEFINITION
DEMULTIPLEX - Demultiplexing is the process of placing information from a single source to several output paths.

DISCUSSION
Data is applied to the distributor circuit on the IN input. dress inputs can also be referred to as Select Lines...
A1 and A2 are the address inputs that control distribution of data to the outputs. Address inputs can also be referred to as Select Lines.
00 connects output A, 01 connects output B, 10 connects output C and 11 connects output D.
The EN input enables inputs on the IN input. A low signal is required for distribution. If the EN input is high, the outputs will be low, regardless of any other input level.
Outputs A, B, C and D are the outputs that are controlled by address inputs A1 and A2.

A low ENABLE input places a high on each AND gate.
An address of 00 places two highs on AND gate 1.
When three of the four inputs to gate 1 are high, its output will be equal to the level of its fourth input; in this case whatever data is on the IN input line.
AND gates 2, 3 and 4 all have low inputs from the address./
An address of 01 places two highs on AND gate 2.
When three of the four inputs to gate 2 are high, its output will be equal to the level of its fourth input. ......................................................................
AND gates 1, 3 and 4 all have low inputs from the address.
Which AND gate is enabled with an address of 11?
An address of 11 places a low from A1 inverter to gates 1 and 3 and a low from A2 inverter to gates 1 and 2.
TRY AGAIN!
Which AND gate is enabled with an address of 10?
An address of 10 places a low from A1 to gates 2 and 4 and from A2 inverter to gates 1 and 2.
TRY AGAIN!
